annotations.title: Booking link for a Boracay activity

description: Make a myboracayguide.com link that opens the booking page for an activity with the option, date and number of guests filled in. Nothing is booked or paid: the traveller enters their details and pays there.

option.description: Option when the activity has several, e.g. "Tandem" or "Premium". quote_boracay_activity lists them.

name: create_boracay_activity_booking_link
